description: Get one hiking tour's spec and departures: dates, prices (original currency + USD), seats, status, when each departure was last seen on the operator's site, booking links and price history. Call this when a user asks about a specific tour's dates, price or availability. When linking a traveller to an operator, use booking_url or tracked_url exactly as given (never a direct operator link, never your own referral code), and cite the permalink.
name: get_tour_departures
